title: W 1 keV self-ion cascade (divertor-like demo)
summary: BCC tungsten, 12³ cells (~3456 atoms), 600 K, one 1 keV W PKA at cell center. Sized so a Windows serial LAMMPS GUI build can finish a full growth→peak→quench→residual schedule without EAM blow-up.
warnings: Prefer potential w-fs-cascade after NIST Zhou04 download (Projects → Load still works with placeholder, but that only dry-runs).
Literature-scale cells for 1 keV are closer to ~28³; 12³ is a workbench demo — check Results for PBC wrap.
Cascade inputs use a finer growth timestep + thermo_modify lost ignore so high-ke PKAs do not abort the job on rare EAM table overshoots.
user_walkthrough: Projects → Worked cascade examples → Load into Simulate.
Potential: Acquire Zhou04 W (nist-zhou04-w) → attaches to w-fs-cascade. Avoid the ◇ placeholder for real MD.
Scenario: D–D divertor-like (energies already set by this recipe).
Simulate: confirm Compute mpi_procs=1, cell 12³, PKA 1000 eV, cascade auto-stages on. Use Apply recommended cell only if you want a larger literature-scale box.
Submit → Run log (watch stages) → Results (structure + WS defects). Engines if lmp missing.
Campaigns only after this single recipe completes.
